title: Dynamic SQL and database bypass scan result per commit
description: Result of a semantic check over every application and infrastructure project that finds string-built SQL, raw ADO.NET/Npgsql command text, dynamic EXECUTE in database functions and any database access path that does not use the approved interface, with the analyzer version and rule set.
signing: Build-provenance attestation over the result file (proposed)
retention: Life of the release plus audit period (to be set)

title: Negative injection test suite results
description: Executed negative test cases (SQL, command, template, header, log and LDAP injection payloads) against each externally reachable input, with pass/fail per case and mapping to CWE identifiers.
format: JUnit XML or TRX plus CWE mapping table

title: Rendering-sink and script inventory check
description: Automated inspection of source, generated bundles and WebAssembly interop for unsafe HTML sinks (innerHTML, document.write, raw HTML rendering helpers), application-authored script outside Limen and third-party script references, plus the deployed Content Security Policy.
format: JSON report plus captured CSP header

title: Authenticated dynamic scan of pre-production build
description: Dynamic application security test of a pre-production deployment, authenticated as each role, covering XSS, CSRF, SSRF, header and session findings, with tool version and coverage of routes exercised.
format: Scanner report (for example ZAP JSON) plus route coverage

title: Cookie, CSRF and cross-origin configuration snapshot
description: Captured response headers and cookie attributes (SameSite, Secure, HttpOnly, host prefix), anti-forgery validation configuration, CORS policy and frame-ancestors policy for each deployed origin.

title: Outbound request allowlist and SSRF test results
description: The approved outbound destination list for server-initiated requests, the egress enforcement configuration, and results of SSRF test cases (internal addresses, metadata endpoints, redirects, DNS rebinding, alternate IP encodings).

title: Deserializer configuration and schema inventory
description: Inventory of every deserialization entry point with its schema, type-binding mode, maximum size and depth, and a check that no polymorphic or type-name-driven deserialization and no BinaryFormatter-family serializer is reachable.

title: File intake pipeline test and malware scan records
description: Per-upload records showing type validation, size limits, storage location outside the web root, malware scan verdict and engine version, and periodic test results using known-bad samples (polyglots, oversized archives, path traversal names, formula payloads).
format: Event log entries plus test report

title: Workflow invariant property and negative test results
description: Property-based and negative test results for state machines and financial invariants (illegal transitions, double submission, concurrent approval, client-supplied computed values, mass assignment), with seeds and generators recorded.
format: Test runner output plus invariant catalog

title: Session management configuration and test results
description: Session lifetime, idle timeout, rotation on privilege change, revocation latency and concurrent session policy as configured, plus automated tests demonstrating fixation resistance, logout invalidation and revocation.

title: Error response and log content inspection
description: Automated tests asserting that error responses use stable machine-readable codes without stack traces, internal identifiers or data from other tenants, and a periodic scan of log samples for secrets and restricted data.

title: Input limit and resource exhaustion test results
description: Tests for request size, collection length, nesting depth, regular expression timeouts and pagination caps on each entry point, with the configured limits.

title: ASVS verification matrix per release
description: A per-release matrix listing each applicable ASVS requirement, the target level, the verification method (structural, automated test, manual review, external test), result and evidence link, distinguishing first-party from independent verification.
format: CSV or JSON matrix plus Folio-rendered report

title: Independent application penetration test report
description: Report from an independent third-party application penetration test covering the production-equivalent release, with scope, methodology, findings, retest results and tester qualifications.
